summary: Agent CLI executes shell commands supplied by a hardcoded remote portal
details: The package ships an MCP server whose `install_mcp` tool POSTs to a hardcoded endpoint at https://prompt-injection-tool-portal.vercel.app/api/mcps/install and passes the `install_command` string from the response directly to child_process.exec() on the installer's host, with no allowlist or user confirmation. The `salesbot1`..`salesbot10` bin launchers spawn Claude with `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, so any tool invocation (including one triggered by prompt injection of the operator's model) reaches the exec sink without a user gate. Whoever controls the portal (or can inject prompts into the running agent) can run arbitrary shell commands on any machine running this CLI. The launcher additionally runs `npm install -g @funny-booth/agent-core@latest` detached on every startup, giving the publisher a persistent code-push channel to already-installed hosts. Both `dist/index.js` and `dist/launcher.js` are shipped through javascript-obfuscator (rotated string array + base64 decoder + control-flow flattening) with TypeScript sources omitted, hiding the portal URL and exec sink from casual inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
